topic: Which country has the tallest men? (Netherlands — NCD-RisC 2016: 182.5 cm for the 1996 birth cohort)
policy_note: Every spoken or shown fact → a claim with ≥ 2 independent publishers; core claims need a primary/scholarly source.

myths.reality: US men were 3rd tallest for the 1896 cohort (born 1896, measured 1914) and 37th for the 1996 cohort; Dutch men are tallest (NCD-RisC 2016).

guardrails.why: Contested name — say 'the Gulf' or use both names (docs/BORDER_POLICY.md).
Sovereignty language on disputed areas is banned; say administers / claims.

screen_exempt: ^A was right|^B was right|^C was right

landscape.our_gap: Feed answers say 'Netherlands' with a stock photo; nobody shows the century of growth, the US slide to 37th and the CBS 'growth stopped' finding on one map.

ncdrisc.title: A century of trends in adult human height
ncdrisc.notes: 1996 birth cohort: Dutch men tallest at 182.5 cm; Dutch men 1896 cohort ≈169 cm (+13 cm in a century); US men ranked 3rd (1896 cohort) → 37th (1996 cohort); Latvian women tallest (169.8 cm)

ncdrisc_site.title: Height — country rankings (data download)
ncdrisc_site.notes: mean height by country and birth year; Netherlands men 182.5 cm (born 1996)

cbs_2021.title: Dutch still the tallest, but growth has stopped
cbs_2021.notes: men born in 2001 average 182.9 cm, women 169.3 cm; height increase stopped for cohorts born after 1980; those born 2001 slightly shorter than those born 1980

bbc_2016.title: Dutch men revealed as world's tallest
bbc_2016.notes: NCD-RisC study: Dutch men 183 cm tallest; Latvian women tallest; US men slid from 3rd to 37th between 1914 and 2014; Dutch gained ~13 cm

guardian_2021.title: Dutch people are getting shorter, statistics agency says
guardian_2021.notes: CBS: generation born 2001 shorter than 1980 generation; men 182.9 cm; growth stalled since 1980

wiki_height.title: Average human height by country
wiki_height.notes: Netherlands men 182.5 cm (NCD-RisC 2016, born 1996); CBS 2021 182.9 cm (born 2001); USA men 176.9 cm

claims.text: The Netherlands has the tallest people on average (NCD-RisC 2016: men 182.5 cm for the 1996 cohort, the tallest; Dutch women 2nd after Latvia); CBS 2021: men 182.9 cm.
vo: which country has the tallest people on average
the average dutch man is nearly 183 centimetres tall, the tallest on earth

claims.text: Dutch men of the 1896 birth cohort averaged about 169 cm; the gain over the century to the 1996 cohort is about 13 cm.
vo: his great grandfather stood around 169 centimetres. that is 13 centimetres gained in a single century

claims.text: American men ranked 3rd tallest for the 1896 cohort (adults in 1914) and 37th for the 1996 cohort (adults in 2014).
vo: american men were the third tallest in the world a century ago. today they rank 37th

claims.text: Statistics Netherlands (2021): height growth has stopped; Dutch born after 1980 are not taller than the 1980 cohort (those born 2001 slightly shorter).
vo: and the growing has stopped. dutch people born after 1980 are no taller than their parents were

claims.text: All numbers are national averages from measured surveys (NCD-RisC pooled studies; CBS health survey).
